Translation: My form and my shadow prostrate to You
And my heart believes in You

Arabic text: هٰذِهِ يَدَايَ وَمَا جَنَيْتُهُ عَلٰى نَفْسِي
Translation: These are my hands and what I have committed against myself
O Great One, who is sought for every great matter

Arabic text: فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ الْعَظِيمَ إِلَّا الرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ
Translation: For none forgives the great sin except the Great Lord
